Credit card transfer bonus FAQ

What are the current credit card transfer bonuses?

As of October 20, 2026 there are 9 current transfer bonuses. The biggest: 50% Rove Miles to JAL (Japan Airlines) Mileage Bank (until October 31), 40% Rove Miles to Flying Blue (until October 31), and 35% Rove Miles to Qatar Privilege Club Avios (until October 31).

Which credit card issuers run transfer bonuses?

We track transfer bonuses from Amex, Chase, Capital One, Citi, and Bilt. Each issuer page lists its live bonuses, typical size and full history.

When is the next Marriott Bonvoy to Cathay Pacific Asia Miles transfer bonus?

Based on 4 historical promotions, Marriott Bonvoy to Cathay Pacific Asia Miles transfer bonuses occur approximately every 134 days. The last bonus ended June 2019. Historically, November and May have been the most common months for this bonus.

When is the next Marriott Bonvoy to British Airways Avios transfer bonus?

Based on 3 historical promotions, Marriott Bonvoy to British Airways Avios transfer bonuses occur approximately every 228 days. The last bonus ended March 2019. Historically, March and September have been the most common months for this bonus.

When is the next Marriott Bonvoy to American AAdvantage transfer bonus?

Based on 4 historical promotions, Marriott Bonvoy to American AAdvantage transfer bonuses occur approximately every 199 days. The last bonus ended October 2019. Historically, September and October have been the most common months for this bonus.
